§98.0802          Definitions

                  For purposes of this Division, defined terms appear in italics. The following
                  definitions apply in this Division:

                  Source of income means all lawful, verifiable sources of income, or rental
                  assistance from any federal, state, local, or nonprofit-administered benefit or
                  subsidy program, or any financial aid from any rental assistance program,
                  homeless assistance program, security deposit assistance program, or housing
                  subsidy program, whether paid directly to the program participant, landlord, or
                  representative of either.

                  Rental-unit has the same meaning as in Municipal Code section 98.0720.

                  Tenancy has the same meaning as in Municipal Code section 98.0720.
                  (“Definitions” added 9-18-2018 by O–20986 N.S.; effective 10-18-2018.)
